Why this should be part of common utility and not VPD specific utility?
This strictly applies on a VPD, so IMO its a better fit there.
Done
Information should be passed to caller that why the data could not be converted? May be a error code?
What action can the caller take if the data could not be converted? I do not see any meaningful action which can be taken.

> What action can the caller take if the data could not be converted?

Don't know, but why should that matter? A utility method, in an error case should set error code?
